exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: quality.es_completion_filter: exclude ES questionnaires taking more than 15 minutes

inputBoundary: One caller-supplied finite nonnegative completion duration in minutes for an already-identified experience-sampling questionnaire, computed from corrected questionnaire start and end timestamps.
outputBoundary: Retain completion durations at or below 15 minutes and exclude durations strictly greater than 15 minutes; equality is retained.
limitations: This binding does not identify experience-sampling questionnaires or derive their corrected start and end timestamps.
Timestamp correction, clock semantics, row ordering, duplicate handling, and duration calculation occur upstream.
The source compares difftime in minutes directly; no integer rounding or sub-minute tolerance is inferred.
The separate rule that removes a later questionnaire less than 60 minutes after the previous questionnaire is not part of this component.
Missing, negative, or nonfinite completion duration fails closed rather than being retained or treated as zero.
